review:
Bells in all their variations – one of the oldest slot symbols, on a modern 5x3, 10-line game. Simple and satisfying.

Wilds double any win they complete in the base game, and the free spins give 15 spins with a 3x multiplier on everything, with unlimited retriggers. It's rated high volatility with a 4,684x max, but the excellent 97.09% RTP and free spins about once every 156 spins make it feel balanced. Same design as Lady Wolf Moon and Lucky Dama Muerta.
